remarks: Located within Westport's coveted private coastal enclave on Saugatuck Island, this sun-filled, 3-4 bedroom home offers relaxed island living in a highly sought-after setting. Hardwood floors run throughout this charming beach house, creating warmth and continuity across well-proportioned living spaces ideal for everyday comfort or weekend entertaining. Three distinct decks extend the living outdoors, perfect for morning coffee, afternoon breezes or evening gatherings. Updated, high-efficiency mechanicals and gas-fired radiant heat provide dependable comfort year-round. Set in a close-knit community known for its never-ending water views, sunsets and seasonal charm, this home is perfectly suited whether you're seeking a year-round residence or a weekend coastal retreat-just minutes from downtown Westport, the train, and major routes.
